changelog:
- Initial release of the Work Productivity Skill Vetter Workflow Helper.
- Provides a structured workflow to review skill usefulness, safety, duplication risk, and quality before install or publish.
- Includes guardrails to prevent vague or redundant skills from being approved.
- Outputs detailed vetting reports, overlap analyses, and actionable recommendations.
- Supports concrete revision suggestions and validation checklists for workflow improvements.
display_name: Work Productivity Skill Vetter Workflow Helper
summary: Vet third-party or generated skills for usefulness, safety, overlap, and publish quality. Use when the user needs to decide whether to install, keep, rename,...
